objective: Fix repeat accumulation of superseded Windows installer cache following a verified update download, without altering published R53/R21 assets or live system networking.

fact.rootCause: app/engine.py update_download previously validated SHA-256 and returned the new installer without pruning prior ROOT/updates/<tag> directories; two stale historical installers R39 and R46 accumulated in the Windows installed runtime.
fact.source: app/engine.py update_download pre-V446; Windows physical scoped updates directory

physicalWindows.scope: Exact 2 versioned installer files; current installation/settings/network routes untouched

decision.method: Prune only immediate historic tagged cache directories containing exactly one recognized FreeNetHub_*_Setup.exe after a NEW installer has a valid published SHA256; avoid symlinks, unknown files, nested directories, unrelated user data or cleanup on failed download.
decision.rationale: Minimum controls prevent accumulation while preserving unknown user files and keeping old installer if the new download fails. No generic recursive purge or forced deletion of locked files.
rejected: Follow symlinks or remove directories containing unknown sidecars
Automatically upgrade the installed R53 binary without a separately accepted release

mutation.scope: Source and integrity metadata only; existing user R53 binary unchanged until future tested release.

junctionSafety.rootCause: On Windows NTFS a directory junction is distinct from a symlink, and Python pathlib.Path.is_symlink may not reject it. Cache GC could follow a junction to an unrelated directory containing a syntactically eligible installer.
junctionSafety.prevention: Skip Path.is_junction() at both updates root and each candidate directory; retain existing symlink and single-file guards.
junctionSafety.evidence: CPython pathlib is_junction Windows-specific API added Python 3.12.
junctionSafety.guard: Hermetic Path.is_junction simulation for root and child candidate, retaining protected file
junctionSafety.risk: User data outside the update cache tree

pythonCompatibility.fact: Path.is_junction() was added in Python 3.12; older supported-environment Python runtimes may lack this API. App launch script probes installed pythonw.exe/python.exe without strict runtime lower-bound.
pythonCompatibility.prevention: If is_junction is unavailable, skip automatic cleanup with no exception and retain every prior installer; new SHA-verified download still returns successfully.
pythonCompatibility.regression: Simulate Path.is_junction unavailable; assert no stale installer removed and no runtime exception.
